description: This file is a shell script that performs system configuration and reset operations, such as updating device settings via 'dmcli' commands, modifying configuration files like '/etc/lighttpd.conf' and '/nvram/syscfg.db', and executing other maintenance tasks related to restoring default LAN settings, self-healing, and resetting system parameters.

methods.name: _update_db_value
methods.description: A shell function that updates specific key-value pairs in the syscfg database file by setting various parameters to zero.
